name: setup-manaflow-ai-docket-look
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces, after the way the best issue trackers read: theme files for color, material and proportions (Docket, dark, the default; Docket Light), settings for 13 px Inter type, a narrow chat column and inbox-like sidebar rows with right-hand times, a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens for a quiet prompt block and keyboard-first menus, and a customize view for an inbox-row hover card. Remove it and everything you had comes back.
